# FinGrab

> FinGrab is a Chrome extension that downloads historical prices (OHLCV) from Yahoo Finance as CSV files, for investors, researchers and traders who work in Excel, Google Sheets or their own analysis tools.

FinGrab adds a button to Yahoo Finance quote pages (stocks, ETFs, indices). One click exports date, open, high, low, close, adjusted close and volume as CSV, in daily, weekly or monthly intervals. The data comes straight from Yahoo Finance and is processed locally in the browser. No signup, no API key.

Pricing: 6 months of prices are free, always, in every interval. 1 year, 2 years, 5 years and full history: 5 free exports, then the paid plan. Payment runs through ExtPay.
